PMC999001Graph Convolution Evaluation Discussion

Renormalized adjacency stabilizes deep propagation across sparse graphs.

 Limitations

We did not evaluate graphs exceeding ten million edges or dynamic heterophily.

 Future Work

Future work should benchmark adaptive edge rewiring under degree shift.
